svg.title: Original PICO-8 starter sprite atlas
svg.desc: Twelve original 8 by 8 pixel sprites with fixed sprite IDs. Color 0 is transparent. Palette indices are shown along the bottom.

g.text: 8 × 8 pixels · fixed IDs 1–12 · sprite 0 stays transparent · GPL-3.0
Standard palette · hexadecimal index · 0 is transparent when drawn as a sprite
